aiTodayFirstHint.en: I picked the customers most worth contacting now and wrote the first message for you.
aiTodayFirstHint.zh: 我已经帮你排好现在最值得先联系的客人，也写好第一句。

aiTodayFirstLoading.zh: 正在帮你排今天先联系谁…

aiTodayFirstEmpty.en: No customer needs attention right now. You can focus on finding new enquiries.
aiTodayFirstEmpty.zh: 现在没有客人需要马上跟进，可以先去找新的询问。

aiConversationTitle.en: Turn a chat into a customer
aiConversationTitle.zh: 贴对话，帮我整理成客人

aiConversationHint.en: Paste the WhatsApp conversation. I’ll pull out the useful details, then you check them before saving.
aiConversationHint.zh: 把 WhatsApp 对话贴进来。我先抓重点，你确认没问题才保存。

aiConversationPaste.zh: 把客人的对话贴在这里…

aiConversationReviewHint.en: I only suggest the details. Edit anything that is not right.
aiConversationReviewHint.zh: 这些只是建议，有不对可以直接改。

aiObjectionTitle.en: Customer said this — what do I reply?

aiObjectionHint.en: Tap a common situation or paste the customer's words. I'll give you 3 safe replies to choose from.
aiObjectionHint.zh: 点一个常见情况，或者贴客人的原话。我给你 3 种安全回法，你选一条就好。

aiFollowupScheduleTitle.en: When should I contact this customer again?

aiFollowupScheduleHint.en: I’ll suggest a sensible time. You choose whether to save it.
aiFollowupScheduleHint.zh: 我先建议一个时间，你确认了才会保存。

aiFollowupScheduled.zh: 下次联系时间已经保存。

aiRepeatTitle.en: Previous customers you can check in with

aiRepeatHint.en: These are real customers who bought before. I wrote a light check-in — use it only if it feels appropriate.
aiRepeatHint.zh: 这些都是真的买过的客人。我写了一句轻轻问候，适合才发，不要硬推。

aiRepeatLoading.zh: 正在看你以前成交过的客人…

aiRepeatEmpty.en: No previous customer is ready for a check-in yet.
aiRepeatEmpty.zh: 现在还没有适合重新联系的旧客。

aiMicroTipTitle.en: One quick tip before you do this

aiMicroTipLoading.en: Getting one useful tip for this step…
aiMicroTipLoading.zh: 正在看这一步最需要注意什么…
